images.filename: 3.7 Inch Anti-Aircraft Gun, Nothe Fort, Weymouth.jpg
images.caption: The 3.7-Inch QF AA was Britain's primary heavy anti-aircraft gun during World War II, the equivalent of the German 88 mm FlaK with a slightly larger calibre of 94 mm. It remained in use after the war until AA guns were replaced by guided missiles in the late 1950s.
images.alt: The 3.7-Inch QF AA was Britain's primary heavy anti-aircraft gun during World War II, the equivalent of the German 88 mm FlaK with a slightly larger calibre of 94 mm. It remained in use after the war until AA guns were replaced by guided missiles in the late 1950s.

images.caption:
Stalls, crafts, people and dogs. From a collection of photographs taken at The Nothe Fort Victorian Weekend 2023.

This popular annual event was held at the hisotric Nothe Fort in Weymouth over the weekend of July 8/9 2023 in a mixture of sunshine and showers!
